rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice, especially for a computer, phone, account, or network password.

example.english: I always forget the password when I log into my account.
example.traditional: 我登入個戶口嗰陣，成日都唔記得密碼。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dang1 jap6 go3 wu6 hau2 go2 zan6 seng4 jat6 dou1 m4 gei3 dak1 mat6 maa5

rows.note: Use this for a secret code or spoken password used to identify people or gain entry, rather than a normal login password.

example.english: Before going in, remember to tell the person at the door the password.
example.traditional: 入場之前，記住同門口嗰個人講暗號。
example.jyutping: jap6 coeng4 zi1 cin4 gei3 zyu6 tung4 mun4 hau2 go2 go3 jan4 gong2 ngam3 hou6
